items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: Finally, old Copeland come down, the secretary, one day.

ctx.x: Yeah, so. So Shaw said, how would you like to work up there? How would you like your band up there? I said, all right. He said, all right, I'll give you a job. I said, okay. Well, it didn't belong to the Union. Well, we played there a couple of weeks, you know. Finally, the cards kept coming there. Well, they had three men playing there. They played for the entertainers. Cora, Cora, Caroline Williams, Florence Mills, Brick Top, Cora Williams, and another girl, Justine, this Justine girl. They played for the…
It was called the Royal Garden.
